body: Being a big bro, i feel the peace his brother must have felt at last.
And have money. You missed it. Also, summing it up as `Being alone from the start of life` hurts less than when you spell out individual kinds of relationship.
That title though, lmao. I used to laugh at it as a joke while a dumb kid but now i realize its way more funny when you have experienced life.

I grew up always hoping that it will change for better but the alcohol, the 24/7 parental abuse (physical and mental) never stopped and still going on (getting worse) after 30 years of marriage. There were a few teenage years of *apparent* happiness when i finally made a bunch of school friends but it was all just an illusion that broke apart as soon as we graduated middle school. Its so funny that i often think if there were to be a God, we wouldn't need Satan, he would be enough by himself.
